Comment: Regional branch of the UK-wide Ecology Party; it later became part of the Green Party (UK) and the Scottish Green Party became independent in 1990.
The Ecology Party was renamed the Green Party in 1985; the Scottish organisation remained part of the UK-wide party until becoming independent in 1990.
Scottish Green Party established as an independent party in 1990.
